title: units.json v0 - the apartments of one project and where they sit in each flight segment

project.description: project id, same as flow.json project and the fixtures/<id> folder

segment_fps.description: optional: frames per second of each flight segment (segment id -> fps), so t <-> frame converts without the segment's camera.json: t_start = (frame - 1) / fps

box_world.description: optional [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1] in plan-world metres (X right, Y up the plan, Z up; floor 16 floor = z 0; z0 = (floor-16) * floor_to_floor (3.2 m), z1 = z0 + ceiling (2.9 m); ground -51.2); projected to hotspots with studio/tools/world2equi.py

outline_world.description: optional true outline of the unit (rooms + walls + terraces) in plan-world metres, same frame as box_world; when present the hotspot hull is built from it instead of the box_world AABB

polygon.description: [[X, Y], ...] plan-world metres (X = x_cm/100, Y = -y_cm/100), open ring

z0.description: floor level of the unit in plan-world metres (default box_world z0)

source.description: where the outline comes from (traced plan, stacked-approx, ...)

type.description: the developer's type letter/name (L, K, M, PH...)

tour_url.description: external URL of the apartment 360 tour (hand-off target); empty-string is not allowed, use the sales page instead

segments.description: flight segment ids for this unit; default descend-<id> / enter-<id>; falls back to flow.defaults

hotspot.description: where the unit is on the equirect of a segment between t_start and t_end seconds. t is in seconds from the segment's FIRST frame (frame 1 = t 0), not from the start of the flight; a per-frame hotspot has t_start = (frame - 1) / fps, t_end = frame / fps. yaw 0 = panorama centre (u = 0.5), positive = to the right/clockwise; pitch positive = up. yaw = (u - 0.5) * 360, pitch = (0.5 - v) * 180.

t_start.description: seconds from the segment's first frame

t_end.description: seconds from the segment's first frame

frame.description: optional segment-local frame (1-based) when hotspots are emitted per frame; t_start = (frame - 1) / fps

visible_frac.description: optional share of the unit's box not hidden by the building on this frame

in_view_hint.description: optional: the unit is inside the director's default framing (view_hint) on this frame

polygons.description: optional multi-part outline: one ring per part (a unit across the u 0/1 seam = 2 parts); replaces the two-record seam split. A reader that knows only polygon keeps working: polygon, when also present, is the largest part

polygon.description: optional outline on the equirect, [[yaw_deg, pitch_deg], ...] (residence.tech-style projected bbox); v0 player draws the marker only

equirect_polygon.description: one ring on the equirect, [[yaw_deg, pitch_deg], ...] (same convention as hotspot.polygon)
